name: OpenBankingConsent
description: Represents a customer's grant of payment consent to a Third Party Provider (TPP/PISP) under the OBIE Domestic Payment Consents API (PSR 2017). Created by SVC-001 when SVC-017 (channel) calls POST /open-banking-consents synchronously. Tracks the full consent lifecycle from awaiting_auth through to terminal states (consumed, revoked, expired). Binds a specific customer (customer_id) to a specific account (account_id) for a single payment to a specific payee at a specific amount. The amount, payee details, and currency are immutable after creation — any mismatch at payment initiation results in rejection (PSD2 RTS dynamic linking requirement). Owned by SVC-001 because consent is a customer-account aggregate, not a channel-layer artefact. Introduced by JRN-010.

fields.name: consent_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-001. Immutable after creation. Returned to TPP as the OB-ConsentId. Must be globally unique.

fields.name: tpp_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → TPPRegistration.tpp_id (ENT-031). Immutable after creation.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Set at PH-037 after SCA. Immutable once set.
fields.transparency_note: Linked to the customer at SCA completion. The customer has given explicit dynamic-linked consent binding them to this specific payment. UK GDPR Article 6(1)(b) and PSR 2017 Reg. 68 consent obligations.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id (ENT-004). Debtor account selected by the customer at PH-037. Immutable once set.

fields.name: consent_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: single_payment | recurring. JRN-010 always single_payment. recurring reserved for VRP flows (JRN-029).

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal. Max 2 decimal places. Min: 0.01. Max: 250000.00 (FPS limit). IMMUTABLE — locked at consent creation; mismatch at PH-038 is mandatory rejection.

fields.name: currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217. Domestic FPS: always GBP. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit UK sort code. Validated against Vocalink EISCD. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit UK account number. Modulus check validated. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 140 characters. Displayed verbatim on consent screen for SCA dynamic linking. Immutable.
fields.transparency_note: Displayed to the customer at PH-037 SCA consent screen to satisfy PSD2 RTS dynamic linking. CoP result shown alongside.

fields.name: payment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Max 35 characters. Immutable.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: awaiting_auth | authorised | consumed | revoked | expired. State machine: awaiting_auth → authorised (PH-037 SCA) → consumed (PH-038 payment). awaiting_auth → revoked (decline). awaiting_auth / authorised → expired (TTL). Terminal: consumed | revoked | expired.

fields.name: sca_completed
fields.validation_rule: Required. Defaults false. Set true atomically with status = authorised. Must be true before payment initiation. Immutable once true.
fields.transparency_note: Audit evidence that SCA was completed per PSR 2017 before payment initiation.

fields.name: sca_method
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when sca_completed = true. Enum: biometric_mobile | sms_otp | hardware_otp. Immutable once set.

fields.name: open_banking_payment_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK → PaymentIntent.payment_intent_id (ENT-008). Set atomically with status = consumed at PH-038. Null until payment initiated.

fields.name: cop_result
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Enum: match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist. Set at PH-037. Immutable once set.
fields.transparency_note: CoP result displayed to the customer at the consent confirmation screen. Retained for APP fraud gross negligence audit.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: authorised_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status → authorised. Immutable once set.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. awaiting_auth TTL: 24 hours from created_at. After authorisation: 90 minutes from authorised_at (OBIE standard).

fields.name: consumed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status → consumed at PH-038. Immutable once set.

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status → revoked. Immutable once set.

relationships.description: OpenBankingConsent belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK. Linked at PH-037 after SCA.
OpenBankingConsent is linked to one Account (debtor) via account_id FK.
OpenBankingConsent is associated with one TPPRegistration via tpp_id FK.
A consumed OpenBankingConsent has exactly one PaymentIntent (ENT-008) via open_banking_payment_id FK. Null until PH-038.

design_decisions.decision: ENT-030 is owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core), not by SVC-017 (channel).
design_decisions.rationale: Consent is a PSR 2017-regulated customer-account agreement. It must persist in the core banking domain alongside Customer (ENT-001) and Account (ENT-004). SVC-017 is a channel layer with no persistent domain state ownership.

design_decisions.decision: Amount, payee details, and currency are immutable on ENT-030 after creation.
design_decisions.rationale: PSD2 RTS on SCA Regulation 97 dynamic linking requires SCA to be bound to the specific amount and payee consented to. Mutating these fields post-SCA breaks the dynamic linking guarantee and is a PSR 2017 breach.

design_decisions.decision: ENT-030.status = consumed and ENT-008 creation are atomic in the same database transaction.
design_decisions.rationale: Prevents a race condition where the consent is consumed but no PaymentIntent exists. No partial state is possible — either both succeed or both roll back.
